From 1f3083aec8836213da441270cdb1ab612dd82cf4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Xiang Mei <xmei5@asu.edu>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 14:20:57 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] netfilter: nfnetlink_log: initialize nfgenmsg in NLMSG_DONE
 terminator

When batching multiple NFLOG messages (inst->qlen > 1), __nfulnl_send()
appends an NLMSG_DONE terminator with sizeof(struct nfgenmsg) payload via
nlmsg_put(), but never initializes the nfgenmsg bytes. The nlmsg_put()
helper only zeroes alignment padding after the payload, not the payload
itself, so four bytes of stale kernel heap data are leaked to userspace
in the NLMSG_DONE message body.

Use nfnl_msg_put() to build the NLMSG_DONE terminator, which initializes
the nfgenmsg payload via nfnl_fill_hdr(), consistent with how
__build_packet_message() already constructs NFULNL_MSG_PACKET headers.

Fixes: 29c5d4afba51 ("[NETFILTER]: nfnetlink_log: fix sending of multipart messages")
Reported-by: Weiming Shi <bestswngs@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Xiang Mei <xmei5@asu.edu>
Signed-off-by: Florian Westphal <fw@strlen.de>

diff --git a/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c b/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c
index f80978c06fa0..0db908518b2f 100644
--- a/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c
+++ b/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c
@@ -361,10 +361,10 @@ static void
 __nfulnl_send(struct nfulnl_instance *inst)
 {
 	if (inst->qlen > 1) {
-		struct nlmsghdr *nlh = nlmsg_put(inst->skb, 0, 0,
-						 NLMSG_DONE,
-						 sizeof(struct nfgenmsg),
-						 0);
+		struct nlmsghdr *nlh = nfnl_msg_put(inst->skb, 0, 0,
+						    NLMSG_DONE, 0,
+						    AF_UNSPEC, NFNETLINK_V0,
+						    htons(inst->group_num));
 		if (WARN_ONCE(!nlh, "bad nlskb size: %u, tailroom %d\n",
 			      inst->skb->len, skb_tailroom(inst->skb))) {
 			kfree_skb(inst->skb);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of the Patch

This patch fixes a kernel heap data leak in the `nfnetlink_log` module. When batching multiple NFLOG messages, the code appended an `NLMSG_DONE` terminator using `nlmsg_put()`, which only zeroes alignment padding but does **not** initialize the `nfgenmsg` payload. This left four bytes of stale heap data exposed to userspace.

### Modifications in `net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c`

**What changed:**  
- In the function `__nfulnl_send()`, the construction of the `NLMSG_DONE` netlink message was changed from:
  ```c
  nlmsg_put(inst->skb, 0, 0, NLMSG_DONE, sizeof(struct nfgenmsg), 0)
  ```
  to:
  ```c
  nfnl_msg_put(inst->skb, 0, 0, NLMSG_DONE, 0, AF_UNSPEC, NFNETLINK_V0, htons(inst->group_num))
  ```

**Why:**  
- `nfnl_msg_put()` internally calls `nfnl_fill_hdr()`, which properly initializes the entire `nfgenmsg` structure (including `res_id` and version fields) instead of leaving uninitialized kernel memory.
- This is consistent with how `__build_packet_message()` already constructs `NFULNL_MSG_PACKET` headers using the same helper.

### Relationship between files

Only **one file** was modified (`net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c`). No cross-file dependencies were introduced or changed—the fix simply uses an existing helper (`nfnl_msg_put()`) already defined elsewhere in the netfilter subsystem.

netfilter: nfnetlink_log: initialize nfgenmsg in NLMSG_DONE

When batching multiple NFLOG messages (inst->qlen > 1), __nfulnl_send()

nlmsg_put(), but never initializes the nfgenmsg bytes. The nlmsg_put()
helper only zeroes alignment padding after the payload, not the payload
itself, so four bytes of stale kernel heap data are leaked to userspace

Use nfnl_msg_put() to build the NLMSG_DONE terminator, which initializes

__build_packet_message() already constructs NFULNL_MSG_PACKET headers.

Fixes: 29c5d4afba51 ("[NETFILTER]: nfnetlink_log: fix sending of multipart messages")
Reported-by: Weiming Shi <bestswngs@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Xiang Mei <xmei5@asu.edu>
Signed-off-by: Florian Westphal <fw@strlen.de>

Here is the root cause:
The function `__nfulnl_send()` used `nlmsg_put()` to construct an `NLMSG_DONE` terminator. `nlmsg_put()` only zeroes alignment padding after the payload, leaving the `nfgenmsg` payload uninitialized. This exposed four bytes of stale kernel heap data to userspace when batching multiple NFLOG messages (inst->qlen > 1).

Here is the patch:
 
 static void
 __nfulnl_send(struct nfulnl_instance *inst)
 {
 	if (inst->qlen > 1) {
-		struct nlmsghdr *nlh = nlmsg_put(inst->skb, 0, 0,
-						 NLMSG_DONE,
-						 sizeof(struct nfgenmsg),
-						 0);
+		struct nlmsghdr *nlh = nfnl_msg_put(inst->skb, 0, 0,
+						    NLMSG_DONE, 0,
+						    AF_UNSPEC, NFNETLINK_V0,
+						    htons(inst->group_num));
 		if (WARN_ONCE(!nlh, "bad nlskb size: %u, tailroom %d\n",
 			      inst->skb->len, skb_tailroom(inst->skb))) {
 			kfree_skb(inst->skb);
 			goto out;
 		}
 	}
 	nfnetlink_unicast(inst->skb, inst->net, inst->peer_portid);
 out:
 	inst->qlen = 0;
 	inst->skb = NULL;
 }
